risk_regions_offered: The calculator does not offer per-country selection; it offers the four aggregated ESC SCORE2 risk-region categories directly (Low risk / Moderate risk / High risk / Very high risk) via an interactive Europe map with a region legend, so the region itself was used per the task's fallback instruction.
global_note: Every patient line's LDL-cholesterol was filled with (non_hdl_chol - 0.1), a value not provided in the source data, because the field is required by the form but was not anticipated by the task. Per the tool's own documentation this does not affect the reported risk10 value for any patient (no patient had statin/ezetimibe/PCSK9 therapy, the only scenario where LDL matters). For 6 diabetic patients (ids 5, 19, 20, 21, 24, 25) the required HbA1c field was also not in the source data; per user instruction these were filled with a fixed placeholder of 53 mmol/mol (the "<7%" treatment-target reference value) — unlike LDL, HbA1c DOES feed into the core SMART2 risk score for diabetics, so risk10 for these 6 patients is an approximation, not an exact result.
